message.content:
Below is a concise list of the **long weekends** that Canadians enjoyed in 2023.  
A “long weekend” is defined as a statutory holiday that falls on a Friday or a Monday (or is observed on a Monday when it falls on a weekend), giving you a three‑day break (Friday‑Saturday‑Sunday or Saturday‑Sunday‑Monday).

| # | Holiday | Date (2023) | Day of Week | Observed (if applicable) | Long‑Weekend Dates |
|---|---------|-------------|-------------|--------------------------|--------------------|
| 1 | New Year’s Day | Jan 1 | Sunday | Observed Mon Jan 2 | **Jan 1–3** (Sat Jan 1, Sun Jan 2, Mon Jan 3) |
| 2 | Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, etc.) | Feb 20 | Monday | — | **Feb 18–20** (Fri Feb 18, Sat Feb 19, Mon Feb 20) |
| 3 | Good Friday | Apr 7 | Friday | — | **Apr 7–9** (Fri Apr 7, Sat Apr 8, Sun Apr 9) |
| 4 | Victoria Day | May 22 | Monday | — | **May 20–22** (Fri May 20, Sat May 21, Mon May 22) |
| 5 | Canada Day | Jul 1 | Saturday | Observed Mon Jul 3 | **Jul 1–3** (Sat Jul 1, Sun Jul 2, Mon Jul 3) |
| 6 | Labour Day | Sep 4 | Monday | — | **Sep 2–4** (Fri Sep 2, Sat Sep 3, Mon Sep 4) |
| 7 | Thanksgiving | Oct 9 | Monday | — | **Oct 7–9** (Fri Oct 7, Sat Oct 8, Mon Oct 9) |
| 8 | Remembrance Day | Nov 11 | Saturday | Observed Mon Nov 13 | **Nov 11–13** (Sat Nov 11, Sun Nov 12, Mon Nov 13) |
| 9 | Christmas | Dec 25 | Monday | — | **Dec 23–25** (Fri Dec 23, Sat Dec 24, Mon Dec 25) |

**Notes**

* **Boxing Day (Dec 26)** fell on a Tuesday, so it was not observed on a Monday and did not create a long weekend.  
* Some provinces have additional holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Ontario, St. John’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, etc.) that may create extra long weekends if they fall on a Friday or Monday.  
* If you’re planning trips for a specific province, double‑check that province’s holiday calendar for any extra long weekends.

Feel free to copy this table into your holiday‑planning app or let me know if you’d like the data in a different format (CSV, JSON, etc.).
